title: Founding Class
dek: Laugh Tale opens its doors with seven names from the Buckaroo Football League's first three seasons: two champion managers and five players who carried titles, honors and a lot of fantasy rosters to the final island.
body: The Founding Class of Laugh Tale covers 2023 to 2025, the Buckaroo Football League's first three seasons, from Buckaroo Bowl I through Buckaroo Bowl III. Seven names make up the first class: managers Kaushal P. and Sonny A., quarterbacks Josh Allen and Trevor Lawrence, running backs Jahmyr Gibbs and Christian McCaffrey, and wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown.

What ties them together is simple: every one of them was there when a Buckaroo Bowl was won. All three champions so far are represented, along with players who wore rings for Habibsters in 2023 and 2024 and for Ben Dover in 2025. Induction is automatic and permanent once a season ends, so nobody here was voted in. They earned their way onto the island.

Two members enter at the rank of Warlord: Josh Allen and Kaushal. The other five, Sonny, St. Brown, Gibbs, McCaffrey and Lawrence, enter as Supernovas. No one reached Emperor or Joy Boy in the first class, which leaves plenty of room at the top for whoever wants it.

Josh Allen arrives as a Warlord with two ways in. He was named Pirate King in 2023 and again in 2024, and he holds the Nami honor across all three founding seasons, 2023 to 2025. No player in this class has more hardware attached to his name.

The numbers back up the trophies. In 56 starts he has put up 1,258 points as a starter, the most of anyone in the class, and his best game was a 51.88-point eruption in 2024 week 14. He has suited up for Kaushal, Ramon and Mekhi, and has been on a BFL roster in every season from 2023 through 2026.

His ring came in Buckaroo Bowl I with Habibsters, the league's first title. That he has also played for Brucie, the league's resident Bills convert, is the kind of detail that makes a Hall of Fame plaque feel personal.

Kaushal enters as a Warlord on the strength of the two most important trophies in league history to that point: Buckaroo Bowl I in 2023 and Buckaroo Bowl II in 2024. He won the first two championships the league ever played, both with Habibsters, the only team he has run.

His resume reads like a dynasty. Habib went 33-19 in the regular season, 4-1 in the playoffs, and averaged 114.3 points per game, the best mark of the two managers in this class. His bounty stands at ฿1,217,000,000, which is a lot of berries for a man who spent the first two years making everyone else pay.

Four of the five players in this class have a ring with Habibsters, which tells you how much of the early league ran through his roster. For two seasons, the road to the Buckaroo Bowl ended at Kaushal's door.

Sonny enters as a Supernova with one way in, and it is a story the league will be telling for a long time: Buckaroo Bowl III in 2025. Ben Dover finished last in 2023 and 2024, then went 13-3 and won the title. Worst to first, all the way to Laugh Tale.

Across his career he is 29-23 in the regular season and a perfect 1-0 in the playoffs, with 105.7 points per game and a bounty of ฿739,000,000. He has run two teams, Ben Dover and now The Horse is Hea.

He is also the only member of the class who can say he built the website hosting his own induction, which is either a fun fact or a conflict of interest depending on who you ask. Either way, the banner is real, and so is the ring.

Amon-Ra St. Brown is in as a Supernova through The One Piece in 2023, the league's first season. He was part of the Habibsters roster that won Buckaroo Bowl I, giving him a ring from the very first title.

His durability is the headline. He has 60 starts, the most of anyone in the class, and 903 points as a starter, with his best game coming at 34.9 points in 2025 week 15. He has played for four managers: Kaushal, Sonny, Randy and Mekhi. Few players have seen as many BFL locker rooms, and every one of those managers had a reason to start him.
Jahmyr Gibbs earns his Supernova rank through The One Piece in 2024, and he carried a ring out of that season too, winning Buckaroo Bowl II with Habibsters.

His 1,055 points as a starter across 59 starts rank second in the class, behind only Josh Allen. His best game was a 49.9-point performance in 2025 week 12, one of the biggest single games any inductee has posted.

Gibbs has passed through four sets of hands: Ramon, Kaushal, Mekhi and Alan. That he now plays for Philly means the rest of the league gets to watch a Hall of Famer score points for the one team most of them would rather see lose.
Christian McCaffrey enters as a Supernova as the Pirate King of 2025. He is the only player in the class with two rings, from Buckaroo Bowl I and Buckaroo Bowl II, both with Habibsters.

In 45 starts he has scored 890 points as a starter, and his best game came early: 45.2 points in 2023 week 4, in the league's first season. He has played for Kaushal, Mekhi and Ramon. If the Habibsters dynasty had a backbone, a strong case can be made it was McCaffrey.
Trevor Lawrence is in as a Supernova through The One Piece in 2025, and his ring came from Buckaroo Bowl III with Ben Dover, the title that completed Sonny's climb from the bottom.

His case is about timing, not volume. Lawrence has just 7 starts and 118 points as a starter, by far the fewest in the class, with a best game of 23.3 points in 2025 week 18. He has played for Ramon, Sonny and Randy, and appeared on BFL rosters in 2023, 2025 and 2026. Laugh Tale does not ask how often you showed up, only whether you mattered when you did.

The Founding Class is a portrait of the league's first three seasons: two years of Habibsters dominance under Kaushal, then the most improbable turnaround in BFL history with Sonny and Ben Dover. Between them, the class holds every Buckaroo Bowl played so far.

It also captures how the league works. Josh Allen, St. Brown, Gibbs, McCaffrey and Lawrence have all changed hands, passing through the rosters of Kaushal, Sonny, Ramon, Mekhi, Randy and Alan along the way. The island is open now, and with eight teams chasing Buckaroo Bowls from 2026 on, the next class is already being written.
